description: Call this tool to write the stored profile to a Word .docx. Returns the output path, the estimated page count, which bullets were dropped to fit, and which keywords matched or are missing.

keywords.description: From the posting. A keyword that appears anywhere in the profile is printed in bold; one that does not is reported as missing and is never added to the resume.

max_pages.description: Bullets are ordered by relevance to target_role and keywords, then trimmed to fit this many pages against a measured word budget. Default 2.

out_path.description: Where to write the .docx. Defaults to <data dir>/documents/<name>-resume.docx, numbered -2, -3, ... if that exists.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing file at out_path. Default false: the call fails and nothing is written.

style.description: Free tier prints "modern" only; "classic" and "compact" are Pro.

target_role.description: Printed under your name and used to rank bullets

name: resume_create
title: Write a resume .docx
